item.title: Starlink Mini as a Failover
item.description:
📝 Enter Starlink Mini# Starlink Mini is SpaceX's compact satellite dish. The UniFi IPv6 Routing Bug# UniFi has a problem where it doesn't automatically assign the default IPv6 route. This is your default gateway.
🔗 Read more: https://www.jackpearce.co.uk/posts/starlink-failover/
